Final CSS polish in d:\Anti-LinkedIn\styles\app.css. Verify and add if missing: html { scroll-behavior: smooth }. .tab-content { padding-bottom: 80px } (must already be there from FEAT-002 — confirm). .bottom-nav bottom-padding safe area: .bottom-nav { padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) }. Smooth tab transitions: .tab-panel.active { animation: fadeInUp 0.25s ease }. Focus visible outlines for accessibility: button:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-yellow); outline-offset: 2px }. Responsive: @media(min-width:768px) block must include: .feed-container max-width override is handled by .app-shell max-width:600px already. .avatar-builder-layout flex-direction:row (from FEAT-002 already). .shop-grid grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) (from FEAT-002 already). .character-grid grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr) (from FEAT-002 already). No additional changes needed if all were written in FEAT-002 — verify and patch only missing rules. Add .post-card hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); transition: box-shadow 0.2s }. Add .btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08) } .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97) }. Add .shop-item-card.owned { border-color: var(--color-success); background: rgba(34,197,94,0.05) }.

START LOCAL HTTP SERVER for live preview in Kiro IDE. After all files are committed, run a background Python HTTP server so the app can be previewed in the browser without file:// CORS issues. Command: python -m http.server 3000 --directory "D:\Anti-LinkedIn" (use run_in_background=true). If that fails, try: python3 -m http.server 3000 --directory "D:\Anti-LinkedIn". Wait 2 seconds then confirm the server is responding. Report these two URLs prominently in your step output: http://localhost:3000/index.html (Landing Page / Waitlist) and http://localhost:3000/app.html (Main App — all 5 features). The user must be able to click these URLs to immediately preview the finished SambatIn app.

Clicking Konfirmasi Bayar fires canvas-confetti burst, closes modal, shows toast, re-renders item as owned
After purchasing kacamata, AvatarBuilder.unlockAccessory is called — kacamata row in avatar builder no longer gates on premium

Profile tab shows: avatar SVG (120px), username, level name in level color, XP bar, sambatan count, reaction count, owned badges
No horizontal scroll at 375px on any tab
No console errors in normal operation of all 5 tabs
